intro: Examples of personal and professional projects demonstrating technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and innovative solutions. Some of them are not finished yet or are in the early stages of development.

projects.title: Harness Useful Family
projects.description: The home of the Harness Useful family: six open source, local-first tools that upgrade a coding agent with a desktop window, workflow skills, project memory, documentation search, a code graph, and a usage meter.

projects.title: Harness Useful Desktop
projects.description: A native desktop app for coding-agent CLIs such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Oh My Pi, and Pi: chat with the agent, browse its sessions and branches, review the changes it made, and manage its configuration and extensions, all locally.

projects.title: Harness Useful Skills
projects.description: Workflow skills for Oh My Pi, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Pi that take a natural-language request through research, planning, implementation, and review to verified work, with focused audits and pull request delivery.

projects.title: Harness Useful Memory
projects.description: A local MCP server that gives AI coding agents project memory: they search it at the start of a task and save fixes, decisions, and locations for the next session, stored per repository in SQLite with full-text search.

projects.title: Harness Useful Knowledge
projects.description: A local MCP server that makes project documentation searchable for AI coding agents, with hybrid keyword and vector search over imported guides, ADRs, OpenAPI specs, and PDFs.

projects.title: Harness Useful Code
projects.description: A local MCP server that indexes a repository with tree-sitter and tells AI coding agents where code is defined, who uses it, and what breaks when it changes.

projects.title: Harness Useful Dashboard
projects.description: A local app that tracks token usage and API-equivalent cost across AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Oh My Pi, with interactive charts, budgets, and an MCP server.

projects.title: Harness Useful Sidebar
projects.description: Live token charts, session history, and account allowances for Oh My Pi in a tmux sidebar and for Claude Code in a native pane, stored locally.

projects.title: Harness Useful Test Portal
projects.description: A local desktop app with practice tests for AI and LLM engineering: timed quizzes or a practice mode by topic and difficulty, with an explanation and sources for every question.

projects.title: Project Palette
projects.description: A project palette generator that allows you to create a palette of similar colors for your project. It is built with React and Vite.

projects.title: Track Things
projects.description: Simplify your tracking journey with a user-friendly platform that transforms your data into meaningful charts. No technical skills or spreadsheets required.

projects.title: Flow of Time
projects.description: This simple project shares only one purpose - to provide you with the the actual, real time information about the flow of time. We all have our limited time on earth as a human being, so each second matters. Make use of it. Do not waste your time.

projects.title: Estimate Electric Car Range
projects.description: Estimate the range of your electric car based on the battery capacity and the driving style.

projects.title: LazyVim Config
projects.description: My personal configuration for LazyVim, a minimalistic and efficient Neovim configuration.

projects.title: SvelteKit Blog
projects.description: My personal blog built with SvelteKit, a minimalistic and efficient blog framework.

projects.title: AI Input Generator
projects.description: A brutalist-styled Svelte 5 application that transforms basic user requests into professional, comprehensive AI prompts. Select your project type, input your request, and get an enhanced prompt ready to use with any AI tool.

projects.title: Svelte CV
projects.description: My personal CV built with SvelteKit, a minimalistic and efficient CV framework.

projects.title: Business Card Style Website
projects.description: This is a basic business card website that you can use as a template for your personal website. It is built using React and Vite.

projects.title: Anna Spiechowicz Website
projects.description: A bilingual (English and German) portfolio website for a Product Owner and Business Analyst, built as a static Astro site with hand-written CSS, inline SVG diagrams, and no client framework.

projects.title: Maciej Spiechowicz Website
projects.description: An earlier version of my personal website, built with React 18 and Vite.

projects.title: Personal Website Template
projects.description: A personal website HTML5 template inspired by the HTML5 UP Identity project.

projects.title: Useful Snippets
projects.description: A collection of useful snippets for various programming languages and tools.

projects.title: Universal OCPP Bridge
projects.description: An in-progress Rust foundation for bridging OCPP chargers to external protocols.

projects.title: Track Things Home Assistant
projects.description: A Home Assistant integration for Track Things with calendar support, automation entry creation, and guided Assist conversations.

projects.title: Oh My Pi Anvil
projects.description: An Oh My Pi extension for specialist-assisted planning, implementation, verification, and review.

projects.title: Pi Config
projects.description: Personal pi.dev configuration with extensions, settings, skills, and themes.

projects.title: Oh My Pi Activity Mask
projects.description: An Oh My Pi activity-animation and presentation extension with masking dependent on host presentation-mask API support.

projects.title: WezTerm Config
projects.description: Personal WezTerm terminal configuration written in Lua.

projects.title: Useful Timer
projects.description: An animated desktop countdown app with multiple independent timers, customizable styles and sounds, and locally saved settings.
